# Zuchen Li (李祖臣)

> Undergraduate at the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, triple majoring in Computer Science, Data Science, and Statistics with a minor in History (GPA 3.8/4.0). Aiming for a PhD in HCI / AI. Previously studied Statistics & Computer Science at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (minor in Meteorology, GPA 4.0/4.0).

Personal homepage: https://lzclink.com/

## Research interests

Human–AI Interaction · Context-Aware Intelligent Systems · Ubiquitous Sensing · AI4Science

## Publications

- MoiréDeform: Towards Fine-Grained Deformation Sensing through Everyday Moiré. Linzhen Zhu*, Zuchen Li*, Weihao Jin, Hyunmin Park, Alanson Sample, Ke Sun (*equal contribution). ACM MobiCom 2026 Demo. https://lzclink.com/projects/moiredeform/
- Generative Tutorial: Towards Live Contextualized Visual Instructions for Physical Tasks. Co-first author; with Profs. Anhong Guo and Xu Wang. CHI 2027, under review. https://lzclink.com/projects/generative-tutorial/
- RespiraFrame: On-Frame Respiratory Monitoring via Electrical Impedance Tomography and Bone-Conduction Acoustics. With Prof. Junyi Zhu. CHI 2027, under review. https://lzclink.com/projects/respiraframe/

## Research experience

- Human Centered Computing Lab, University of Michigan — Undergraduate Research Assistant (Sept 2025 – present):
  - Generative Tutorial (co-first author; with Profs. Anhong Guo and Xu Wang): co-developed a conceptual framework and AR system for live contextualized visual instruction that grounds physical-task goals in users' workspaces and proactively generates workspace-specific goal images and demonstration videos; co-led a formative evaluation of 176 generated artifacts across 15 tasks and a 24-participant comparative study showing improved task quality, perceived workspace correspondence, and shorter step-confirmation intervals over pre-authored guidance.
  - MoiréDeform (co-first author, ACM MobiCom '26 Demo; with Profs. Alanson Sample and Ke Sun): low-cost camera-based sensing that exploits naturally occurring woven textures as virtual moiré layers to amplify subtle surface deformation — continuous body-lean interaction and respiratory waveform/rate sensing on an unmodified mesh chair; reduced respiratory-rate MAE from 2.07 to 0.71 breaths/min relative to physical-marker tracking.
  - RespiraFrame (with Prof. Junyi Zhu): experimental design and evaluation of an eyeglass-based multimodal respiratory sensing system (bone-conduction acoustics + electrical impedance tomography); evaluation protocols spanning respiratory behaviors, motion and environmental interference, a three-day semi-wild study, and a four-week longitudinal study.
- Generative AI for Music and Audio, University of Michigan — Research Assistant, advised by Prof. Herman Dong (Sept 2025 – present): real-time human–GenAI co-creation for controllable music generation; gesture-driven interaction techniques.
- Energy Distance Dimension Reduction, University of Michigan — Selected Researcher, Undergraduate Research Program in Statistics (URPS), advised by Prof. Kerby Shedden (Jan – May 2025): engression and sufficient dimension reduction for multilevel, dyadic, and longitudinal wearable data; JAX GPU re-implementation with ~7,000× speedup.
- Lab of Atmospheric and Earth System Sciences, Nanjing University — Summer Research Intern, advised by Prof. Minghuai Wang (May – Aug 2024): statistical ML integrating sensor observations with simulated atmospheric data for aerosol–cloud interactions.
- E2-E Lab, UIUC — Undergraduate Research Assistant (Aug 2023 – May 2024): PIV flow-field reconstruction (Python, OpenCV, OpenPIV) and CFD simulation (ANSYS Fluent).

## Selected projects

- MagicBaton: gesture-based human–AI music interaction — dual-IMU smart conducting baton (12-axis motion at ~50 Hz), real-time edge gesture recognition, jerk-based beat/BPM estimation, MIDI playback, in-browser Magenta MusicRNN; public dataset of ~934 recordings across 8 gesture classes. https://lzclink.com/projects/magicbaton/
- Multimodal Finite State Machine for Adaptive Skill Guidance: VLM visual cues + YAMNet audio fused with a 12-state machine for real-time hand-washing guidance; switchable local Qwen3-VL and Gemini backends. https://lzclink.com/projects/adaptive-skill-guidance/
- How Fragile Are GUI Agents? A Controlled Perturbation Benchmark for Interface Evolution: five interface-evolution categories, controlled synthetic websites, VisualWebArena harness. https://lzclink.com/projects/gui-agent-fragility/
- Bayesian MCMC Data Augmentation for Ebola Outbreak Data: partially observed, censored onset/removal data. https://lzclink.com/projects/ebola-mcmc/
